sources.entry: Mailcow - Mail server suite based on Dovecot, Postfix and other open source software, that provides a modern Web UI for administration. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/PHP
mailcow | Full mail server suite with webmail, antispam and a management UI

summary.one_liner: mailcow: dockerized is a self-hosted mail server suite that runs Postfix, Dovecot and other open source components in Docker, with a web UI for administration.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly points to the official documentation for installation and support, so the feature list here relies on the awesome-selfhosted and awesome-selfhost-docker listing descriptions. Those listings describe it as a mail server suite based on Dovecot and Postfix, with a modern web UI for administration, webmail and antispam. The README itself confirms it is packaged for Docker ("dockerized") and that it bundles various open-source software. Installation details are not in the README and must be taken from the external documentation.
use_cases: self-hosting a mail server for a domain
running email for a small team or organization
managing mailboxes through a web admin panel
providing webmail and spam filtering for users
how_to_run: See the official mailcow documentation for installation instructions (not included in the README).
notable: Complete mail server suite packaged for Docker
Web UI for mailbox and domain administration
Built on Postfix and Dovecot with antispam and webmail, per listing descriptions
Maintained by The Infrastructure Company GmbH, with commercial support contracts offered by Servercow
caveats: README defers installation and support to external documentation; little detail is given in the repository itself
Commercial support is offered through a Servercow support contract, and a SAL one-time payment option is mentioned
mailcow is a registered word mark of The Infrastructure Company GmbH
keywords: host email on my own server
